accepted.s: The Planning Commission of India came into being along with which Budget?
accepted.x: The Planning Commission was formally set up on 15 March 1950 and came into being with the Budget for 1950–51.
accepted.tq: Use the closely spaced financial years as the numerical trap.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: The establishment of the Planning Commission in 1950 was recommended by the Advisory Planning Board headed by
accepted.x: The Advisory Planning Board of 1946, headed by K.C. Neogi, recommended the establishment of the Planning Commission.
accepted.tq: Match the recommendation with the correct committee chairman.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: Who was the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission?
accepted.x: Gulzarilal Nanda was the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission; M.S. Ahluwalia was its last Deputy Chairman.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the first and last office-holders.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: Who was the last Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission?
accepted.x: M.S. Ahluwalia was the last Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission before it was replaced by NITI Aayog.
accepted.tq: Test the end-point of an office-holder sequence.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: The Planning Commission was modelled broadly on the
accepted.x: The Planning Commission was modelled on the Soviet Gosplan planning organisation.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional model rather than the institutional status.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the position of the Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission?
o: A Cabinet-minister-rank functionary and de facto head of the Commission
A constitutional authority with voting rights in the Cabinet
A representative nominated by the State Governments
A Secretary-rank officer appointed by the Finance Commission
accepted.x: The Deputy Chairman was the de facto head of the Planning Commission, held Cabinet-minister rank and attended Cabinet meetings without a vote.
accepted.tq: Separate rank, functional headship and voting power.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT a component of the Planning Commission's regular composition?
o: A Member-Secretary drawn from the senior IAS
The Governors of all States as members
The Finance Minister as an ex officio member
accepted.x: States and Governors were not represented in the composition of the Planning Commission. It included the Prime Minister, Finance and Planning Ministers ex officio, expert members and a Member-Secretary.
accepted.tq: Use the wrong-membership trap in a composition question.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: The full-time expert members of the Planning Commission generally held the rank of
o: Secretary to the Government of India
accepted.x: The Planning Commission included four to seven full-time expert members who held Minister of State rank.
accepted.tq: Test the precise rank attached to expert membership.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s: Which one of the following was an attached office of the Planning Commission from January 2009?
accepted.x: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) was an attached office of the Planning Commission from January 2009.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an attached office from a related planning body.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission - resolution year, chairman, deputy chairman, status

accepted.s:
Which one of the following combinations correctly associates a task with the responsible institution?
1. Assessing the country's resources — Planning Commission
2. Preparing the draft plan — Planning Commission
3. Providing budgetary allocation for plan spending — Finance Ministry
4. Approving the draft plan as the apex planning body — National Development Council
accepted.x: The Planning Commission assessed resources and prepared the draft plan; the Finance Ministry handled budgetary allocation, while the National Development Council approved the draft as the apex approving body.
accepted.tq: Assign each function to the correct institution before selecting the code.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission vs NDC vs Finance Ministry - who assesses, formulates, approves

accepted.s: Which institution was responsible for prescribing guidelines for the national plan, including assessment of the resources required for it?
accepted.x: The National Development Council prescribed guidelines for formulation of the national plan, including assessment of the resources required, and approved the draft plan.
accepted.tq: Read the wording of the function carefully instead of relying on the institution's general role.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission vs NDC vs Finance Ministry - who assesses, formulates, approves

accepted.s: After approval by the National Development Council, the plan was processed through which broad sequence before becoming the operative document?
accepted.x: The National Development Council approved the draft; final approval was given through the Union Cabinet and Parliament, making it the operative document.
accepted.tq: Follow the institutional flow from draft approval to final authorisation.
accepted.sec: Planning Commission vs NDC vs Finance Ministry - who assesses, formulates, approves

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Development Council:
1. It is neither a constitutional nor a statutory body.
2. Its recommendations are legally binding on the Union and the States.
3. It is an advisory body associated with the planning process.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The National Development Council is neither constitutional nor statutory and functions in an advisory capacity. Its recommendations are not binding.
accepted.tq: Reject the absolute claim that advisory recommendations are legally binding.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: The National Development Council was expected to meet at least
accepted.x: The National Development Council was required to meet at least twice a year.
accepted.tq: Test the minimum frequency using close numerical alternatives.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: Which one of the following was NOT included among the members of the National Development Council?
accepted.x: Governors were not members of the National Development Council. Its membership included the Prime Minister, Union Cabinet Ministers, State Chief Ministers, UT Chief Ministers or Administrators, and Planning Commission members.
accepted.tq: Use the constitutional-office trap in a membership question.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: Since 1967, which group was included in the membership of the National Development Council?
o: All Chairpersons of District Planning Committees
accepted.x: All Union Cabinet Ministers were included in the membership of the National Development Council from 1967.
accepted.tq: Focus on the date-linked change in institutional composition.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s:
Which of the following was NOT an objective of the National Development Council?
1. Securing the cooperation of States in the plan
2. Mobilising resources
3. Promoting common economic policies
4. Exercising judicial review over State plans
accepted.x: Securing State cooperation, mobilising resources and promoting common economic policies were objectives of the Council. Judicial review was not one of its functions.
accepted.tq: Identify the unrelated constitutional function among planning objectives.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: The National Development Council aimed particularly at promoting
o: balanced and rapid development of all regions
accepted.x: One of the objectives of the National Development Council was balanced and rapid development of all regions.
accepted.tq: Select the balanced-development objective rather than an extreme centralising alternative.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: The Sarkaria Commission recommended that the National Development Council should be given constitutional status under
o: Article 263 and renamed the National Economic and Development Council
Article 243ZD and renamed the District Development Council
Article 280 and renamed the Finance Council
Article 356 and renamed the Union Development Council
accepted.x: The Sarkaria Commission recommended constitutional status for the Council under Article 263 and suggested the name National Economic and Development Council.
accepted.tq: Match the recommendation with both the correct Article and proposed name.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the National Development Council is correct?
o: It was converted into the Finance Commission.
It became a constitutional body after 2015.
Its formal abolition resolution is still pending, while its role has passed to the Governing Council of NITI Aayog.
It was formally abolished immediately after the creation of NITI Aayog.
accepted.x: A formal resolution for abolishing the National Development Council remains pending, while its role has effectively passed to NITI Aayog's Governing Council.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a body's effective replacement of role from its formal abolition.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: The recommendations of the Balwantrai Mehta Committee were accepted by the National Development Council in
accepted.x: The National Development Council accepted the Balwantrai Mehta recommendations in January 1958.
accepted.tq: Use the sequence of nearby planning years as the date trap.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: The National Planning Council, constituted in 1965, was
o: a parliamentary committee on public accounts
an expert advisory body attached to the Planning Commission
a committee of the Finance Ministry for tax devolution
a constitutional body replacing the Planning Commission
accepted.x: The National Planning Council constituted in 1965 was an expert advisory body attached to the Planning Commission.
accepted.tq: Separate the similarly named National Planning Council from the National Development Council.
accepted.sec: National Development Council - year, chairman, secretary, members, functions

accepted.s: In the Constitution of India, “Economic and social planning” is included in
accepted.x: Economic and social planning is placed in the Concurrent List under Entry 20 of List III.
accepted.tq: Use the List–Entry combination rather than the subject alone.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s: The objectives of economic planning in India are primarily derived from the
accepted.x: Planning objectives draw substantially from the Directive Principles of State Policy.
accepted.tq: Identify the constitutional source of planning objectives.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s: The establishment of the Planning Commission was particularly in line with the constitutional direction contained in
accepted.x: The Planning Commission was established in line with the objectives reflected in Article 39 of the Directive Principles.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among Articles by linking planning with the relevant Directive Principle.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Institution or provision)
a. Planning Commission
b. National Development Council
c. District Planning Committee
d. Metropolitan Planning Committee
List-II (Reference)
i. Article 243ZE
ii. Article 243ZD
iii. 1950
iv. 1952
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: The Planning Commission was established in 1950, the National Development Council in 1952, District Planning Committees are covered by Article 243ZD, and Metropolitan Planning Committees by Article 243ZE.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure Article pairs and then complete the year pairs.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the planning machinery referred to in the Indian constitutional and administrative framework?
o: Finance Commission, Election Commission, State Planning Boards and Gram Sabhas only
National Development Council, Parliament and High Courts only
Planning Commission, National Development Council, State Planning Boards, District Planning Committees and Metropolitan Planning Committees
Planning Commission, Union Public Service Commission and State Finance Commissions only
accepted.x: The planning machinery included the Planning Commission, National Development Council, State Planning Boards, District Planning Committees and Metropolitan Planning Committees.
accepted.tq: Select the complete institutional chain rather than a partial list.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s: District Planning Committees are provided for under Article
accepted.x: Article 243ZD provides for District Planning Committees, whereas Article 243ZE concerns Metropolitan Planning Committees.
accepted.tq: Separate the two closely related planning-committee Articles.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s: Metropolitan Planning Committees are provided for under Article
accepted.x: Article 243ZE provides for Metropolitan Planning Committees; Article 243ZD relates to District Planning Committees.
accepted.tq: Use the final-letter distinction between the two neighbouring Articles.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding the constitutional position of economic planning?
o: Economic planning is a residuary subject administered only by the President.
Economic and social planning is a Concurrent List subject, enabling both the Union and the States to legislate on it.
Economic planning is not mentioned anywhere in the Seventh Schedule.
Economic planning is exclusively a State subject and cannot be legislated upon by Parliament.
accepted.x: Economic and social planning appears as Entry 20 in the Concurrent List, allowing both the Union and the States to legislate on the subject.
accepted.tq: Apply the meaning of Concurrent List classification to legislative authority.
accepted.sec: Planning and the Constitution - Concurrent List, DPSP, planning machinery
